sees: frame 1: A worried-looking cartoon man in a dark blue-grey shirt on a light card, next to a small icon of three dark people figures labeled TRIBE.

frame 2: The man and the whole scene have turned grey/desaturated. An orange circle now surrounds the three-people TRIBE icon. A curved arrow runs from the circle over the man's head to a large empty phone-or-container shape labeled UNIQUE INFORMATION that has only a small dark bar filled at the bottom.
frame 3: Same as frame 2: grey worried man, orange circle around TRIBE, arrow pointing to the mostly empty UNIQUE INFORMATION container.
changed: The tribe icon got circled in orange, the man went grey, and a new mostly empty UNIQUE INFORMATION container appeared with an arrow from the tribe to it.
cause: The tribe (group) seems to be the source the arrow links to the container, i.e. staying inside the tribe leads to little unique information; the man is greyed to de-emphasize him.
effect: The container stays nearly empty, suggesting that the tribe provides very little unique information.
message: Being locked into your tribe leaves you with very little unique information, which worries the person.
wouldConfuse: The container looks like a phone or battery, and the arrow direction (tribe to container) could be read as the tribe filling it rather than failing to; the greyed man is ambiguous.
